articles.title: Iran adds 11 more ships to Hormuz blacklist

The move comes a week after Tehran blacklisted ⁠45 tankers from the Strait of Hormuz, warning that any vessel cooperating with a banned ship would also be added to the list.  PGSA, a body set up by Iran to manage the strait, now prohibits 56 vessels from transiting the critical waterway.

"Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT??? Like America itself, it would be 'hotter' than ever before!" he said. It is the latest geographical name change floated by Trump and comes a week after he ordered Lake Ontario to be renamed as "Lake America".
